verse.verse_1: By the Fig and the Olive,
verse.verse_4: We have indeed created man in the best of moulds,
verse.verse_5: Then do We abase him (to be) the lowest of the low,-
verse.verse_6: Except such as believe and do righteous deeds: For they shall have a reward unfailing.
verse.verse_7: Then what can, after this, contradict thee, as to the judgment (to come)?
verse.verse_8: Is not Allah the wisest of judges?
